Name: Bentleys Fast Food Useful Stuff
Author: BentleyThemodder
Description:
Bentley's Fast Food & Useful Stuff

Description:
Hey everyone! This mod adds a full fast-food restaurant right to your farm. Built this for Nick (nicholasgilomen), and it includes a custom buildable building, a walk-in interior, a working order counter shop, and 5 custom items with unique stats and buffs.

Installation Instructions:
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Download this mod and unzip it.
3. Drop the BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff folder into your Stardew Valley /Mods/ folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

(Safe to add to existing save files!)

Main Features:
- Buildable Fast Food Restaurant: Head over to Robin's shop to build Bentley's Fast Food. It costs 0g, needs no materials, and takes 2 days to build.
- Walk-In Interior: You can walk inside the building, check out the interior layout, and use the order counter to buy food.
- Custom Items & Buffs:
  * Cheeseburger: Restores 45 Energy and Health.
  * French Fries: Restores 18 Energy and Health.
  * Coke: Restores 15 Energy/Health and gives +1 Speed (Fizzy Rush buff).
  * Farmhand Snack Pack: Restores 32 Energy/Health and gives +1 Farming & +1 Mining (Trail Energy buff).
  * Windex: Gag item. Loses 10 Energy, gives -1 Speed & -1 Luck (Windex Dizzy debuff).
- Crafting & Shops: Crafting recipes unlock automatically on day start. Items are also sold over at Gus's Saloon.

Requirements:
- Stardew Valley (1.6.15 or higher)
- SMAPI (v4.1.10 or newer)
- Content Patcher

Shout Outs:
Huge thanks to Nicholas Gilomen (nicholasgilomen) for helping out with the dialogue, testing, and project ideas! Thanks as well to Pathoschild and the community for making Stardew modding tools.

NEW VERISON INCLUDES NO DLL
